summary: Continuation and research policies omit the reconciled configuration contract.
evidence: src/types.ts:53-65 defines only four unrelated optional fields per policy. The reconciled configuration in .research/orchestrator-phases/synthesis.md:291-315 requires continuation settings including mode, retry limits, provider auto-resume, stagnation, lease, checkpoint, and exhaustion policy; and research settings including github, sandboxing, stdout cap, citations, adaptation plan, and injection mode. These settings cannot be represented or type-checked.
suggestedRemediation: Expand ContinuationPolicy and ResearchPolicy with the documented reconciled fields and literal unions where the configuration has finite choices.
